base_member_text: [L1-L128] (LOW/working-directory/contract) All source paths are hard-coded relative paths and the batch file does not establish its own directory, so execution from any other working directory targets the wrong locations.
audit_member_text: [L1-L4] (MED/working-directory-contract) Source paths are resolved from the caller's working directory without anchoring to the batch location, so launching the script elsewhere targets the wrong tree or fails.

base_member_text: [L1-L128] (MED/destructive/error-handling) Every formatter output is moved over the original source immediately, with no per-command error check or rollback, so a missing findent executable or failed formatting step can leave the source set partially transformed or replaced.
audit_member_text: [L1-L128] (HIGH/destructive-error-handling) Every formatter invocation is followed by unconditional move /Y, so a missing or failing findent can replace original sources with empty or incomplete redirected output.

adversarial.rationale: All 64 formatter commands in trunk/lib/fortran/findent/indentcode.bat are followed by unconditional move /Y, and the generator make_indentcodebat.m:19-23 emits the same unchecked pattern. A bundled findent.exe reduces the ordinary missing-executable scenario but provides no failure guard: with existing readable inputs and writable output paths, command redirection can leave empty or partial .new files that the next command overwrites the originals with.
